items.title: Commodity derivatives: new penalty formula and position limits
items.summary: Revises the penalty formula for position limit breaches, the definition of “Broad Commodity” and client-level position limits.

items.title: ETF price band circular: deadline moved to 7 September
items.summary: Implementation of the 15 June 2026 circular on ETF base price, price bands and pre-open call auction was pushed from 1 to 7 September.

items.title: FPIs can sign powers of attorney to custodians digitally
items.summary: Digital signatures under the IT Act are accepted, so notarisation, apostille and consularisation are no longer required.

items.title: Privately placed municipal bonds: face value and escrow norms
items.summary: Sets ₹1 lakh and ₹10,000 face value norms, adds SPV escrow rules and extends financial result filing deadlines.

items.title: Digital accessibility audits: deadline extended to 31 October 2026
items.summary: Regulated entities get more time to complete accessibility audits and fix the findings. Other obligations are unchanged.

items.title: GARUDA mechanism lets AIFs launch schemes faster
items.summary: AIF schemes can launch without waiting for SEBI’s PPM review, using merchant banker certification or self-certification.

items.title: Amendment directions on matters to be placed before bank boards
items.summary: Amends the directions on what banks must put before their boards, effective 1 October 2026.

items.title: Custodian fee moves from annual to monthly
items.summary: Replaces the annual fee with a monthly fee payable within 15 days of month-end, effective 1 October 2026.

items.title: Notification 21/2026-Customs (T): duty exemption for tariff item 26020010
items.summary: Amends Notification 62/2022-Customs to exempt goods under this tariff item from basic customs duty.

items.title: Notification 01/2026-Central Tax (Rate): beverage rates aligned
items.summary: Updates the list of goods with specific GST rates to match the Finance Act 2026.

items.title: Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2026
items.summary: MCA notification dated 12 August 2026 amends the Ind AS rules under the Companies Act, 2013.

items.title: General Circular 03/2026: CCFS-2026 extended to 31 August 2026
items.summary: The Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 now runs to 31 August 2026, after MCA21 data centre disruption in June.

items.title: General Circular 02/2026: DPT-3 deadline extended to 31 July 2026
items.summary: The DPT-3 (return of deposits) filing for FY 2025-26 can be made till 31 July 2026 without additional fees.

items.title: G.S.R. 432(E): minimum capital for Registered Valuers Organisations
items.summary: Amends the valuer rules to require paid-up share capital of at least ₹25 lakh, with transition time for existing organisations until 31 March 2028.

items.title: General Circular 01/2026: Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026
items.summary: A one-time scheme for companies to clear pending annual filings, with reduced additional fees, or to apply for dormant status or strike-off.

items.title: Liquidation Process (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2026
items.summary: IBBI notification dated 22 September 2026 amending the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (Liquidation Process) Regulations.

items.title: Circular on appearance through video conferencing or physical mode
items.summary: Supreme Court circular dated 18 May 2026 on how counsel may appear in hearings.

items.title: Circular F.No. 3/Judl./2026: procedure for letters seeking adjournment
items.summary: Fresh directions on circulating adjournment letters, superseding the circulars of 29 November and 2 December 2025.
